g.text: Test. Stood in the plant room with the light off and the
recorder running and did not move for six minutes.
Nothing changed. Walked the corridor out with the light on
and it was the corridor I came in by, every cell of it.
Test. Same corridor. Light off, and I ran.
It was a different corridor by the time I stopped.
It moves where it has not been heard. It moves where it has
not been heard. It moves where
So make noise, and it stands still, and the noise brings
the other thing. Or hold still, and it rearranges, and the
other thing does not know where you are.
That is not a trap. That is a price list.
